visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A toddler with pigtails wearing a floral tank top and denim shorts stands beside an adult's legs in a bright, minimalist indoor hallway. (2) The toddler begins to cry, furrowing her brow and opening her mouth while an adult nearby holds a yellow book. (3) The scene shifts to a bright bathroom/makeup area where a woman in a cartoon-print shirt sits on a stool; a blonde makeup artist in a denim overall dress applies products to her face. (4) The toddler watches from the threshold, still appearing distressed and holding a white object. (5) The woman sits while the artist uses an eyelash curler; the toddler, now being held by the woman, watches the procedure with wide, curious eyes. (6) Close-up of the toddler touching the woman's face and pointing toward her eyes as the artist continues applying mascara with a wand. (7) The toddler is given a white cotton swab; she holds it with focused intensity and mimics the makeup application by dabbing it on her own temple and then the woman's hand. (8) The toddler leans in close to the adult's hand, meticulously dabbing the cotton swab on the skin with a very serious facial expression. (9) The toddler looks at a large black makeup kit filled with various cosmetics on a wooden counter. (10) The toddler appears slightly disappointed, looking down while still holding the swab. (11) Final sequence shows a pink background with a cartoon character illustration and text.
